Why buy from a real shop?

A bed is something you’ll use every night for years. It deserves more than a guess and a delivery slot.

Try it before you buy

Lie down, roll over, sit on the edge. Five minutes in the showroom tells you more than fifty online reviews ever will.

Receipt & warranty with every purchase

Proper paperwork, every time. If anything goes wrong, you know exactly where to come — and we’ll be here.

NBF approved quality

Our mattresses are approved by the National Bed Federation, so you can buy with confidence in how they’re made.

Friendly local staff who know beds

We’ve been helping Belfast sleep better for over 20 years. Tell us how you sleep and we’ll point you to the right bed — not the most expensive one.
